examples: The manager does not have the authority to approve such a large budget alone.
مدیر به‌تنهایی اختیار تأیید چنین بودجه بزرگی را ندارد.
Local authority over zoning decisions often leads to conflict with state regulations.
اختیار محلی در تصمیمات منطقه‌بندی اغلب با مقررات ایالتی در تعارض قرار می‌گیرد.
The coach spoke with such authority that even the senior players listened carefully.
مربی با چنان اقتدار صحبت می‌کرد که حتی بازیکنان باتجربه هم با دقت گوش می‌دادند.
miniContext: Authority refers to the power or right to give orders, make decisions, or enforce obedience. A police officer has the authority to stop traffic, while a judge has the authority to decide a legal case. People sometimes question authority when they believe a decision was made unfairly or outside the proper limits of someone's power.

examples: Her teacher always tried to encourage students who struggled with math.
معلم او همیشه سعی می‌کرد دانش‌آموزانی را که با ریاضی مشکل داشتند تشویق کند.
Good coaches encourage their players even after a difficult loss.
مربی‌های خوب بازیکنان خود را حتی بعد از یک شکست سخت تشویق می‌کنند.
The company wants to encourage employees to suggest new ideas without fear of criticism.
شرکت می‌خواهد کارمندان را تشویق کند تا بدون ترس از انتقاد ایده‌های جدید پیشنهاد دهند.
miniContext: To encourage someone means to give them support, confidence, or hope so that they continue trying. Parents who encourage curiosity often raise children who enjoy learning throughout their lives. A single encouraging comment from a mentor can sometimes change the direction of someone's entire career.

examples: The dove is widely recognized as a symbol of peace.
کبوتر به‌طور گسترده به‌عنوان نماد صلح شناخته می‌شود.
In chemistry, each element is represented by a one- or two-letter symbol.
در شیمی، هر عنصر با یک نماد یک یا دو حرفی نشان داده می‌شود.
For many families, the old house remained a symbol of better times.
برای بسیاری از خانواده‌ها، آن خانه قدیمی نمادی از روزهای بهتر باقی ماند.
miniContext: A symbol is an object, image, or sign that represents a deeper idea or meaning beyond its literal form. Flags act as a powerful symbol of national identity, capable of stirring strong emotion in citizens. Writers frequently use a symbol, such as a storm or a broken mirror, to hint at a larger theme in their story.

examples: The old barn was infested with vermin, including rats and mice.
آن انبار قدیمی پر از جانوران موذی از جمله موش‌های صحرایی و موش‌های خانگی بود.
Farmers set traps around the field to control the vermin that destroy crops.
کشاورزان دور مزرعه تله گذاشتند تا جانوران موذی که محصولات را نابود می‌کنند را کنترل کنند.
City officials hired a company to remove vermin from the abandoned building.
مقامات شهری شرکتی را استخدام کردند تا جانوران موذی را از آن ساختمان متروکه خارج کند.
miniContext: Vermin is a general term for small, troublesome animals, such as rats, mice, or insects, that damage property or spread disease. Cities often struggle to control vermin in crowded areas where garbage is not properly managed. Historically, outbreaks of disease have sometimes been linked directly to the presence of vermin in overcrowded housing.

examples: The referee is supposed to remain completely neutral during the match.
داور قرار است در طول مسابقه کاملاً بی‌طرف بماند.
Switzerland has a long history of staying neutral during European wars.
سوئیس تاریخ طولانی بی‌طرف ماندن در طول جنگ‌های اروپایی دارد.
The mediator tried to find a neutral location where both sides would feel comfortable.
میانجی سعی کرد مکانی بی‌طرف پیدا کند که هر دو طرف در آن احساس راحتی کنند.
miniContext: Someone or something neutral does not take sides or show favoritism in a conflict or disagreement. Countries that declare themselves neutral during a war try to avoid supporting either side militarily. A neutral tone of voice can also help de-escalate an argument between two angry people.

examples: Before signing the contract, please consider all the possible risks.
قبل از امضای قرارداد، لطفاً تمام خطرات احتمالی را در نظر بگیرید.
The committee will consider three candidates for the position next week.
کمیته هفته آینده سه نامزد را برای این موقعیت در نظر خواهد گرفت.
Many scientists consider climate change to be the most urgent issue of our time.
بسیاری از دانشمندان تغییرات آب‌وهوایی را فوری‌ترین مسئله عصر ما در نظر می‌گیرند.
miniContext: To consider something means to think about it carefully before forming an opinion or making a decision. Employers consider many factors besides experience, such as attitude and willingness to learn. Before moving to a new city, it helps to consider the cost of living, job opportunities, and distance from family.

examples: The fierce storm knocked down several trees along the coast.
آن طوفان شدید چند درخت را در طول ساحل از ریشه کند.
Competition among the top universities has become increasingly fierce in recent years.
رقابت میان دانشگاه‌های برتر در سال‌های اخیر به‌طور فزاینده‌ای شدید شده است.
The lioness looked fierce as she guarded her cubs from the approaching hyenas.
آن شیرماده هنگام محافظت از توله‌هایش در برابر کفتارهای در حال نزدیک شدن، درنده به نظر می‌رسید.
miniContext: Fierce describes something intense, aggressive, or powerful, whether it is an animal, a storm, or a competition. A fierce debate broke out among the board members over the company's new direction. In nature, predators often appear fierce when protecting their territory or their young from a threat.

examples: The baby began to wail loudly the moment her mother left the room.
نوزاد به محض اینکه مادرش اتاق را ترک کرد شروع به ناله بلند کرد.
Mourners began to wail loudly as the coffin was lowered into the ground.
عزاداران به محض اینکه تابوت داخل زمین پایین برده شد، شروع به زاری بلند کردند.
The wind seemed to wail through the old house at night.
به نظر می‌رسید باد شبانه از میان آن خانه قدیمی ناله می‌کرد.
miniContext: To wail means to cry out loudly in grief, pain, or sorrow. At traditional funerals in some cultures, mourners wail openly as a way of expressing their loss. Writers sometimes describe the wind as wailing through an abandoned house to create an eerie, sorrowful atmosphere.

examples: He refused to argue over such a trifle as who would wash the dishes.
او حاضر نشد بر سر چیزی کم‌اهمیت مثل اینکه چه کسی ظرف‌ها را بشورد بحث کند.
She was annoyed that they wasted an entire meeting discussing a mere trifle.
او ناراحت بود که آن‌ها یک جلسه کامل را صرف بحث درباره یک موضوع کم‌اهمیت کردند.
Don't let a trifle like a missed bus ruin your entire day.
نگذار یک چیز کم‌اهمیت مثل از دست دادن اتوبوس تمام روزت را خراب کند.
miniContext: A trifle is something of very little importance or value, often mentioned to show that an issue is not worth serious concern. Couples sometimes argue over a trifle, such as which movie to watch, when a deeper frustration is actually the real cause. In British English, trifle is also the name of a layered dessert, unrelated to its meaning here.

examples: Many employees detest pointless meetings that waste half the workday.
بسیاری از کارمندان از جلسات بی‌فایده‌ای که نیمی از روز کاری را هدر می‌دهند بیزار هستند.
He claims to detest dishonesty, yet he lies constantly himself.
او ادعا می‌کند از نادرستی بیزار است، در حالی که خودش دائماً دروغ می‌گوید.
She has always detested the smell of cigarette smoke.
او همیشه از بوی دود سیگار بیزار بوده است.
miniContext: To detest something means to dislike it intensely, often with a feeling close to hatred. People commonly detest certain chores, such as cleaning the bathroom or filing taxes, even though they know they must be done. Strong opinions about food often come down to a single ingredient that someone happens to detest.

examples: He began to scowl as soon as he read the disappointing news.
او به محض خواندن آن خبر ناامیدکننده شروع به اخم کردن کرد.
The teacher would scowl whenever a student arrived late without an excuse.
معلم هر وقت دانش‌آموزی بدون دلیل دیر می‌رسید اخم می‌کرد.
She tried not to scowl at the rude customer, but it was difficult to hide her irritation.
او سعی کرد به آن مشتری بی‌ادب اخم نکند، اما پنهان کردن ناراحتی‌اش سخت بود.
miniContext: To scowl means to make an angry or displeased facial expression, usually by frowning deeply. A manager who scowls during meetings can make employees nervous about sharing new ideas. Children sometimes scowl at their parents when told they cannot have something they want.

examples: He tends to sneer at anyone who disagrees with his opinion.
او عادت دارد به هر کسی که با نظرش مخالف باشد با تمسخر نگاه کند.
The critics sneered at the film's low budget special effects.
منتقدان افکت‌های ویژه کم‌هزینه فیلم را با تمسخر زیر سؤال بردند.
She could not help but sneer when he claimed to be an expert on the subject.
او نتوانست مانع از تمسخر خودش شود وقتی آن مرد ادعا کرد در این زمینه کارشناس است.
miniContext: To sneer means to show contempt or scorn through a mocking facial expression or tone of voice. Online commenters sometimes sneer at beginners instead of offering helpful advice. A sneer can communicate disrespect more effectively than words, which is why it often provokes a strong reaction from the person on the receiving end.
